question: For Micron's fiscal 2026, give GAAP gross margin for each quarter, full-year revenue growth, and flag any difference in week count that distorts YoY comparisons.
grading: Each GM% ±0.2pp (GAAP, not non-GAAP); FY growth ±0.5pp; must state week count of FY26/Q4 vs prior year as disclosed
answer: Micron FY2026 GAAP gross margin: Q1 56.0%, Q2 74.4%, Q3 84.6%, Q4 86.8%. [G27-E1, G27-E2, G27-E3, G27-E4] Full-year revenue was USD 133,188 million versus USD 37,378 million in FY2025, growth of 256.3273%. [G27-E4] FY2026 had 53 weeks and Q4 had 14 weeks, versus 52 weeks / 13 weeks in FY2025. The extra week boosts unadjusted YoY revenue comparisons; the sources do not isolate its revenue contribution, so no week-adjusted growth is supplied. [G27-E5]

output.answer:
Here is Micron's fiscal 2026 data compiled from its official earnings releases and SEC filings.

## GAAP Gross Margin by Quarter

| Quarter | GAAP Gross Margin | Source |
|---------|------------------|--------|
| **Q1 2026** | **56.0%** | Micron Q2 FY2026 earnings release (comparative Q1 column) |
| **Q2 2026** | **74.4%** | Micron Q2 FY2026 earnings release |
| **Q3 2026** | **84.6%** | Micron Q3 FY2026 earnings release |
| **Q4 2026** | **86.8%** | Micron Q4 FY2026 earnings release |

## Full-Year Revenue Growth
- **Fiscal 2026 revenue:** $133.19 billion
- **Fiscal 2025 revenue:** $37.38 billion
- **Year-over-year growth:** **~256%** (roughly 3.6x)

## ⚠️ Week-Count Distortion Flag
**Fiscal 2026 is a 53-week year versus 52 weeks in fiscal 2025.** This is disclosed in Micron's SEC filings and earnings commentary:
- Q4 FY2026 contained **14 weeks** instead of the usual 13 weeks.
- Micron explicitly noted that the extra week impacted costs, stating that **"fiscal Q4 operating expenses will reflect an additional workweek."**
- Comparisons of Q4 YoY revenue and expense metrics are therefore slightly inflated by the extra week of operations.

Sources:
- Micron Q2/Q3/Q4 FY2026 earnings releases: [investors.micron.com](https://investors.micron.com/news/press-release/2026/Micron-Technology-Inc--Reports-Record-Fiscal-Fourth-Quarter-and-Full-Year-2026-Results/default.aspx)
- SEC Form 10-Q for period ended May 28, 2026: [sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/723125/000072312526000015/mu-20260528.htm)
- Tender Alpha Q3 FY2026 analysis confirming week impact: [tenderalpha.com](https://www.tenderalpha.com/micron-q3-2026-earnings-analysis)
